tabs.content:
union
    (orders_current()      | summarize rows = count() | extend tbl = "orders"),
    (order_items_current() | summarize rows = count() | extend tbl = "order_items"),
    (customers_current()   | summarize rows = count() | extend tbl = "customers"),
    (products_current()    | summarize rows = count() | extend tbl = "products")
| project tbl, rows
tabs.title: Tab
